findings.explanation: We looked at 39 of your buys that had a full year of earlier prices to check for a pattern. Four of them, or 10%, happened right after a big rise in the share's price. Since about 10% of buys would happen after a big rise by luck alone, your results are not more than chance. This means the pattern of buying after a sharp rise was not detected.
